messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 5xx/error rate detected for inference-api-prod. Alert threshold exceeded (5m window). Severity: S2. PagerDuty incident PD-4892 created. War room: https://warroom.internal.redwood/PD-4892 (expires in 4h). Please ack and assign an owner.
Alex K: Acked. I'm on-call for this shift — grabbing ownership of triage & initial comms. Opening war room.
Sam R: I can take infra-side debugging (GPU cluster / autoscaler). Joining war room now.
Maria G (SRE): Thanks. Alex, please confirm user-impact scope (latency vs errors). Priya, loop in support for potential customer message.
Priya N: On it — drafting a short customer note template in thread.
Alex K: Initial quickcheck: 5xx rate rose from ~0.2% to 6.8% starting 12:03 UTC. Error signature shows repeated backend: "kv-cache-miss -> null pointer" in logs. No recent deploys to prod in last 6 hours per deploy-bot.
PagerDuty Bot: Reminder: please ACK the PD incident to stop escalation until confirmed.
Alex K: Acked PD-4892. Owner: Alex K. War room pinned.
Support Bot: Note: 2 customer-facing tickets already created (C-2248, C-2251) by support triage at 12:12 UTC. Both report widespread inference failures across sessions.
Sam R: Jumping into GPU pool metrics: saw a spike in GPU memory usage around 12:02 UTC on nodes gpu-pool-7. Some pods OOMKilled and restarted (see pod logs below).
Sam R: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gpu-pool-7
inference-abc-7   CrashLoopBackOff   3/5   12:04
inference-def-3   Running            1/1   12:06
```
Alex K: Rolling plan: 1) Confirm customer impact and update status page, 2) Identify root cause (infra vs model), 3) Apply mitigations (scale down batch size / restart affected nodes / fallback to smaller model), 4) Postmortem owner.
Maria G (SRE): Priority: stabilize traffic first. If we can route traffic to healthy pools or enable fallback model variants, do that ASAP. Sam, can you evict pods from gpu-pool-7 and spin up replacements in gpu-pool-3/4?
Sam R: Starting node cordon + drain for gpu-pool-7 now. Will spin replacement pods in gpu-pool-3.
Alex K: Action: I'll prepare an internal status update for stakeholders and a short statuspage draft.
Priya N: Customer-facing template (SHORT): "We're investigating increased failures on Redwood Inference (inference-api-prod). Engineering is actively triaging. We'll post updates in ~15 minutes or sooner. Impact: some requests may fail with 5xx. No data loss expected."
Priya N: Customer-facing template (DETAILED): "We are currently investigating increased error rates on inference-api-prod that may cause failed requests or timeouts. Our SRE and infra teams are actively triaging. We have identified affected GPU nodes and are performing controlled node restarts and fallback routing. We'll follow up with a timeline and next steps shortly. If you have critical incidents, please contact your CSM or reply to this message."
Alex K: I'll post the SHORT message to status.redwood.com as 'investigating' and link the public status incident to internal PD-4892.
PagerDuty Bot: Note: automatic escalation suspended for 10 minutes after ack.
Ops Rotation: Handoff note for next oncall at 13:00 UTC: Alex (owner) will continue till stabilization; Sam is infra lead; Maria is SRE lead for postmortem.
Maria G (SRE): Triage checklist update: collecting core dumps, checking KV cache health, verifying recent quantization patch rollout (v1.3.2) — rollback if correlated.
Sam R: Drain complete for gpu-pool-7, replacement pods coming up on gpu-pool-3. Observability: 5xx rate dropping to 3.1% after drains and partial routing changes. Still above normal.
Alex K: Posting statuspage: "Investigating — Increased errors on inference-api-prod affecting some requests. Engineering investigating; mitigation in progress. Follow this incident for updates. (link to war room)"
Support Bot: Customer note posted to priority customers list. Waiting for more guidance before wide broadcast.
Priya N: If we need to send a wide customer notification, recommend using the DETAILED template and include ETA for fix if known.
Alex K: Short-term mitigation options on table: 1) Route to smaller model variant (reduced memory pressure), 2) Reduce batching to avoid OOMs, 3) Temporarily scale up GPU instances in region. Which do we want to try first?
Sam R: I'm triggering scale-up of 2 extra nodes in us-west-1 (controlled). If OOMs persist, we'll fallback to smaller model.
Maria G (SRE): Decision: scale-up + reduce batching by 50% immediately. If error rate doesn't drop below 1% in 10m, initiate model fallback.
Alex K: Noted. I'll update the war room timeline and post a 15m check-in.
Sam R: Scale-up in progress — new nodes healthy. Metrics show 5xx at 1.2% and trending down.
Alex K: 15m check-in: error rate 0.9% and falling, customer impact reduced. Keeping incident open for monitoring and postmortem. I will author the incident report template and assign Maria as postmortem lead.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-4892 status set to 'acknowledged'. Next escalation in 60 minutes if not resolved.
Maria G (SRE): Thanks all. Final action items: Sam to collect node-level logs and heapdumps, Alex to publish timeline and update stakeholders, Priya to hold customer comms. Postmortem due EOD tomorrow.
Support Bot: Closing the two customer tickets with interim note pointing to statuspage; we'll reopen if customers report ongoing issues. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: Wrapping up in war room shortly. If anything regresses, re-ping with @here. Good work team.
